question: Why are beings described as the offspring of Maheśvarī?
premises: Beings bear the marks of liṅga and yoni
inference: Because beings bear both marks, they are the offspring of Maheśvarī.
uncertainties: bhagāṅkī refers to the mark of the yoni; rendered functionally
plain_english: Marked by the liṅga and marked by the yoni, therefore the beings are the offspring of Maheśvarī.
